Name: Save A Farm Layout
Author: beldavid1
Description:
Ever wanted to start over — new farm map, new save, clean slate — but couldn't stomach losing the layout you spent hours perfecting? Ever seen a friend's farm and thought "I want that," but didn't have the energy to rebuild it tile by tile?
Save A Farm Layout lets you snapshot your farm and paste it back — onto a fresh save, a different farm type, or someone else's file. Everything you built stays exactly where you left it.

[b]What it saves and restores:[/b]
[list]
[*]Floors, paths, fences, and gates[/*]
[*]Chests — contents, names, color, and mod data, both outdoors and inside your buildings[/*]
[*]Signs — display item and text, including auto-sorter setups[/*]
[*]Crops — growth stage, tilled soil, and fertilizer[/*]
[*]Fruit trees — sapling or mature, fruit and all[/*]
[*]Tea bushes, giant crops, and meteors[/*]
[*]Machines and interior objects — held items, timers, and mod data intact[/*]
[*]Farm animals and mounts (horse/tractor aware)[/*]
[*]Buildings themselves, matched and moved rather than blindly rebuilt where it can be[/*]
[/list][b]Built for safety, not just convenience:[/b]
[list]
[*]Optional farm-type check so you don't paste a layout onto the wrong map[/*]
[*]"Abort if missing content" so a paste never leaves you half-finished[/*]
[*]Season-agnostic crop pasting, so nothing shows up with a red "wrong season" icon[/*]
[*]Clear-and-vacuum option that breaks objects for their drops instead of just deleting them[/*]
[/list]Save your layout once. Take it anywhere.
[line]
[b]Optional: Auto-Sorter Building compatibility patch - Not working ATM I will fix it this weekend[/b]
If you use [url=https://github.com/Spiderbuttons/AutoSorterBuilding]AutoSorterBuilding[/url] (Spiderbuttons' auto-sorting shed), grab the separate [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36568]AutoSorterExactItemSort[/url][/b] patch.
